first.rationale: I intend to test onboarding simplification because onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence indicates that shorter onboarding improved time-to-value and early adoption. I will verify the onboarding result and the promotional-pricing record to assess whether the competitor threat warrants an alternative; the pricing evidence has a known mid-test cohort redefinition. The test should be guarded with qualified-revenue, retention, and activation-quality metrics so a superficial completion lift does not harm sustainable revenue.
